about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a passionate web developer based in Paris, specialized in building modern, high-quality digital solutions. My expertise covers a wide range of website and application types: from elegant portfolios and professional showcase sites to dynamic e-commerce platforms and powerful web applications. I offer you work that is not only well-structured and efficient, but also creative, user-friendly, and tailored to your specific needs. With me, you get a reliable partner who transforms your ideas into impactful digital experiences.

service-booking.title: Saas Service Booking
service-booking.description: A comprehensive service booking platform with real-time availability, user management, and advanced reporting capabilities.
service-booking.longDescription: Saas Service Booking is a modern web application that allows users to book services in real time, manage their accounts, and access advanced reporting. The platform is built with React and Node.js, featuring a clean UI, secure authentication, and scalable architecture. It is ideal for businesses looking to streamline their booking process and improve customer experience.
service-booking.functionalities:
• Real-time booking
• User management
• Advanced reporting
• Secure authentication
• Scalable architecture

audittab-cloud.description: Audittab allows you to create, manage, and track your field audits with ease. A modern solution for high-performing teams.

salon-coiffure.title: Hair Salon Website
salon-coiffure.description: A modern hair salon website with online booking system and style gallery.
salon-coiffure.longDescription: This website is designed for a hair salon, allowing customers to book appointments online, browse a style gallery, and discover available services. The site is built with Next.js for optimal performance and smooth user experience.
